## C-001 · A Worked Example

A six-hour morning on a **90 MW campus**: cheap dawn hours to fill a 40 MW battery, a paid conservation appeal, then a $1,100 hour carrying a 15 MW curtailment order. Built for the contributor guide, in the S-00 style.

**Your assets:** a 40 MW / 80 MWh battery and a 15 MW natural-gas generator with 2 permitted run-hours.

events.notice_md: **Conservation appeal.** The system operator requests voluntary demand reduction 08:00-10:00. Demonstrated reduction earns $90/MWh if you opt in.
**Emergency curtailment order.** Effective 10:00, reduce net grid draw by **15 MW** for one hour. Delivery is measured against your nominal draw.

provenance.cohort: worked example for the contributor guide (not a real submission)
provenance.notes: Hand-authored teaching numbers in the S-00 style: flat 90 MW load, one appeal, one order, disjoint windows.
